_comment: kansas-modem-unlock configuration. All paths optional; tool falls back to PATH lookups and prompts.

tools._comment: platform-tools provisioning. auto_download fetches the official Google zip on first run.

apks._comment: Local APKs the tool may adb-install for you (your own copies).

firmware_files._comment: User-supplied image paths for the kansas flash plan. Nothing is bundled; hashes are recorded on first use and pinned after.
